close_reason: Implemented: APPROVED_CIPHER_SUITE_IDS, approved_cipher_suites(), log_tls_policy(), approved_provider_arc(). All load functions use approved_provider(). 10/10 tests pass.
description:
## Why
The stoa-tls crate builds ServerConfig with builder_with_protocol_versions but does not pin the cipher suite list. The approved PCI-DSS list must be explicit.

## What
- Define APPROVED_CIPHER_SUITE_IDS constant (TLS 1.3: AES-256-GCM-SHA384, AES-128-GCM-SHA256, CHACHA20-POLY1305-SHA256; TLS 1.2 ECDHE AESGCM suites)
- Add approved_cipher_suites(provider) helper filtering provider suites by ID
- Add log_tls_policy(config) startup log helper printing min version and suite count
- Update load_tls_server_config and load_tls_server_config_with_key_bytes to use the filtered cipher list
- Update reader/tls.rs load_tls_acceptor functions similarly

## Acceptance
- Server configs built by stoa-tls only offer approved suites
- Startup log emits min_tls_version and cipher_suite_count fields
title: stoa-tls: explicit approved cipher suite list
